{{Top|leg}}
A '''holostar''', also called a '''holoactor''' or '''holo-celebrity''',<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a noted performer in [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]]. Holostars were quite often wealthy from their success in the entertainment industry and widely recognizable. Notable holostars included [[Amber Jevanche]];<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> [[Garik Loran]];<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref> [[Tetran Cowall]];<ref name="Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> [[Rex Shaxrigge]];<ref name="CSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Syal Antilles Fel]], known as Wynssa Starflare;<ref name="mabf">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref> and [[Javul Charn]].<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>
